# Araya OptiNiSt

> Araya OptiNiSt is a no-code scientific data analysis platform for neuroscience and related research workflows.

## Summary
- Product: Araya OptiNiSt
- Category: Scientific data analysis platform / web application

## Suggested description
Araya OptiNiSt is a no-code cloud platform for scientific data analysis. It helps researchers build analysis pipelines visually, improve reproducibility, and collaborate using browser-based workflows.

## Key topics
- no-code scientific workflows
- neuroscience data analysis
- calcium imaging analysis
- reproducible research workflows
- NWB-compatible pipelines
